products.name: Boys' Black Lace-Up School Shoe
products.subtitle: Formal Uniform · 4-Eyelet Lace-Up
products.shortDescription: Formal black lace-up school shoe engineered with a removable cobalt-blue EVA fitting insert, quick-dry breathable mesh lining, and anti-slip outsole for everyday Indian school wear.
products.description: Built for daily school assemblies, classrooms, and playground runs, the Boys’ Black Lace-Up pairs a clean formal uniform profile with GrowStep’s removable blue EVA fitting insert. As your child’s foot grows, removing or replacing the insert frees controlled internal room while keeping the lace-up heel and midfoot secure.
products.materialsConstruction:
Upper: Water-resistant PU-coated microfibre for formal appearance and wipe-clean maintenance.
Inner Lining: Quick-drying, moisture-managing breathable polyester mesh.
Footbed: Cushioned grey EVA foam base.
Fit-Adjustment Insert: Engineered die-cut blue EVA adaptive fitting insert.
Toe & Heel: Reinforced toe cap and structured heel counter with black-and-white pull tab.
Outsole: Non-marking anti-slip rubber/TPR outsole.
products.adaptiveFitMechanism:
Stage 1: Shoe arrives with the blue EVA fitting insert installed over the grey cushioned footbed for a snug initial fit.
Stage 2: As the child’s foot grows, parents check toe clearance regularly.
Stage 3: Removing or replacing the blue EVA insert opens controlled additional room inside the shoe. Note: Accommodating approximately one additional size is a proposed design capability requiring prototype validation. Always stop wearing if the shoe feels tight.
products.careInstructions: Wipe the PU-coated microfibre upper with a damp cloth after muddy or rainy school days. Remove the blue EVA insert and footbed to air-dry naturally in shade—do not machine wash or expose to direct heat.
products.shippingReturnsSummary: Configurable standard shipping across India (4–6 business days). Size exchanges and returns follow our configurable store policy.
features: Removable blue die-cut EVA fitting insert
Reinforced toe cap & heel counter with striped pull tab
Quick-dry mesh lining & anti-slip TPR outsole

products.name: Girls' Black Mary Jane School Shoe
products.subtitle: Formal Uniform · Single Adjustable Strap
products.shortDescription: Classic black Mary Jane school shoe with an easy single adjustable strap, subtle vamp ventilation pores, removable blue EVA fitting insert, and monsoon-ready outsole.
products.description: Designed to meet Indian school uniform guidelines while supporting growing feet, the Girls’ Black Mary Jane pairs a neat single adjustable strap with a cushioned collar, reinforced toe protection, and our removable blue EVA fitting insert.
products.materialsConstruction:
Upper: Easy-clean, water-resistant PU-coated microfibre.
Closure: Single wide adjustable hook-and-loop instep strap for a secure custom fit.
Inner Lining: Quick-drying breathable polyester mesh.
Footbed & Insert: Cushioned grey EVA footbed paired with removable blue die-cut EVA fitting insert.
Outsole: Non-marking anti-slip rubber/TPR outsole.
products.adaptiveFitMechanism:
Stage 1: Start with the blue EVA fitting insert in place for comfortable initial support.
Stage 2: Check fit periodically as your child grows.
Stage 3: Remove or replace the blue EVA insert and readjust the single instep strap for controlled additional room. Target of approximately one additional size is a proposed design capability requiring prototype validation.
products.careInstructions: Wipe upper clean with a soft damp cloth. Keep strap hook-and-loop surfaces free of lint. Air-dry removable blue insert and footbed away from direct sunlight.
products.shippingReturnsSummary: Configurable standard shipping across India (4–6 business days). Size exchanges and returns follow our configurable store policy.

Removable blue die-cut EVA fitting insert

products.subtitle: Physical Education · Single Adjustable Strap
products.shortDescription: Crisp white unisex physical education shoe with an easy single adjustable strap, breathable perforated toe box, quick-dry mesh collar, removable blue EVA fitting insert, and anti-slip outsole.
products.description: Engineered for sports periods, PT drills, and active school days, the Unisex White PE School Shoe keeps feet cool with fine vamp perforations and breathable mesh lining while offering quick single-strap fastening, easy wipe-clean maintenance, and GrowStep’s adaptive blue EVA fitting insert.
products.materialsConstruction:

Closure: Wide single adjustable strap for fast school-morning wear.
Inner Lining: Quick-dry breathable grey polyester mesh for active moisture management.
Footbed & Insert: Cushioned grey EVA footbed with removable blue die-cut EVA fitting insert.

products.careInstructions: Wipe white PU-coated microfibre upper after playground use with mild soap and a damp cloth. Remove the blue EVA insert to air-dry in shade.
